audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells the player that Steadfast Presence negates his gap-close: 'Steadfast Presence (W) negating your gap-close and dashes', 'Steadfast Presence blocking your gap-close', 'Use Steadfast Presence (W) to block your dashes and ground you'.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence stops enemy DASHES — 'If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded'. Garen has no dash anywhere in his kit; Decisive Strike is 'a burst of Move Speed', a run-up, not a dash. Her W therefore cannot stop, slow or ground Garen's approach at all. Three separate lines currently teach the player to fear a spell that does nothing to him, which changes whether he commits.
audit.corrected: Her W stops dashes; your Q is a movement-speed burst, so it walks straight through the ring. What she actually gets from W against you is the move speed and the passive resists.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict's untargetable channel and Iron Ambassador's shield are not stated.
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions and confirmed by the kit: her R (140/120/100s) is a channel carrying untargetable, so a Demacian Justice spent into it is thrown away; her passive buckler grants a temporary shield when she picks it up, which eats the burst window your execute threshold depends on.
audit.corrected: Hold the execute until Keeper's Verdict resolves; force the buckler shield out before you commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2, Level 3 and Level 6 are marked 'Skill' in both layers while the packet gives all three to Garen and each row's why-text already says Garen is ahead.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Poppy] at a 52.04% Garen win rate. Poppy's early kit is defensive; Garen's short trades and Perseverance win every stage until she completes tank items.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3 and 6 flip to Garen 6/10, conceding only 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Charge's cooldown is stated without a rank, and the packet flags zero sequencing advice.
audit.why: Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s and only stuns if it pushes you into a wall; Hammer Shock is 8s at rank 1 and Steadfast Presence 20s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 14s at rank 1, and the counterplay is fighting away from walls rather than dodging the dash.

audit.why: Garen wins every laning stage and loses only the fully-built tank duel; early/mid/late prose matches once the W claim is fixed.

edits.before: Track Poppy’s Heroic Charge (14s): Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Heroic Charge (14s at rank 1): the wall-pin stun. Fight off walls, or wait it out.

edits.before: Get E-pinned on a wall. Get R-knocked mid-execute. Extend into her W. Save the R for moments with names on them.
edits.after: Get E-pinned on a wall. Get R-knocked mid-execute. Fear her W as if you had a dash. Save R for named kills.

edits.before: Track his Poppy Poppy Steadfast Presence ring and Heroic wall smash before you commit
edits.after: Track Heroic Charge (14s at rank 1) and her passive buckler shield before you commit

edits.before: Keeper's Verdict (R) can cancel your all-in or ult you away, but 1v1 with W tenacity and Q silence you still hold the trade edge.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (140s) is a channel that knocks you away and hides her — hold your execute until it resolves, then take the 1v1 you win.

edits.before: Poppy flips it — full tank with Steadfast Presence (W) negating your gap-close and dashes, plus Heroic Charge stuns, she out-tanks your damage and peels forever.
edits.after: Poppy flips it — full tank, she out-tanks your spin and peels forever with Heroic Charge wall-stuns; her W only stops dashes, and your Q is a speed burst, not one.

edits.before: Poppy takes over late — as a full tank with Steadfast Presence blocking your gap-close and Heroic Charge stuns, she out-tanks your damage and peels herself indefinitely.
edits.after: Poppy takes over late — a full tank whose Heroic Charge wall-stuns and armour outlast your spin; Steadfast Presence stops dashes only, so your Q run-up still reaches her.

edits.before: Use Steadfast Presence (W) to block your dashes and ground you
edits.after: Use Steadfast Presence (W) for move speed and its resists

notes: Headline fix: Steadfast Presence cannot stop Garen, because Garen has no dash — Decisive Strike is a Move Speed burst. Three lines told the player otherwise. Note for the mirror when poppy__garen is audited: her page must not claim the W ring answers Garen's engage either. Level chart proposed as one atomic group across both layers. Packet suspectName 'Use Steadfast Presence' is a FALSE POSITIVE on the name (it is her real W) — the line was still rewritten, but for the mechanic, not the spelling. Not asserted: whether Garen's Q silence can interrupt the Keeper's Verdict channel (the kit says any CC cancels it, but does not settle silence), so the advice is to hold the execute rather than to interrupt.
